ItemId.description: Optional unique identifier of the queue group. When it matches a stored queue group, that queue group is updated. Otherwise a new queue group is created under this identifier, so references to it from other entries and steps keep resolving.

Properties.description: Extension data other features attach to the queue group, keyed by the name of the settings object (for example channel-specific routing settings). When present, it replaces the stored extension data as a whole.

QueueGroups.description: The Contact Center queue groups to create or update.
